title: Session Preview Everywhere & Real Sentence Links
changes: Session preview now appears before every mission kind — mastery-skill practice and topic boss challenges now show which words are new and which are review, not just chapter and topic sessions.

New-word selection now actively looks for a genuinely linked pair — two new words where one's example sentence contains the other — so you learn them together and then see them combined in a sentence-bridge card.
Fixed a matching bug where a word could be wrongly flagged as "linked" just because its kanji happened to appear inside a longer, unrelated word (e.g. 日 inside 日本).
